business.what: India's second-largest forging company (Kolkata; Jalan family). Closed-die hot, warm and cold forgings, ring rolling and, since FY25, iron castings, mostly machined, for commercial vehicles in India, North America and Europe, plus railways, mining/earth-moving, oil & gas, PV/EV and industrial customers.
business.plants: 20 manufacturing facilities (Jamshedpur/Saraikela in Jharkhand, Kolkata, Chakan, Gurugram machining, castings at RCSL); warehouses and sales offices in the US, Mexico and Brazil.

utilisation.note: Press +3,000 t (Jan-2026) and +40,000 t (Mar-2026); casting +28,800 t in RKFL (31-Mar-2026); RCSL press +18,000 t (Dec-2025).

rtrwl.name: Ramkrishna Titagarh Rail Wheels (51%, equity-accounted JV with Titagarh Rail Systems; not yet in commercial production at Mar-26)

guidance.revenueFY29: Rs8,000 cr by FY29 (one year later than the earlier FY28 target), ~22-25% CAGR from FY26's Rs4,238 cr (Naresh Jalan)
guidance.exportsFY27: 'almost 20% plus' growth; exports ~35% of consolidated revenue; 'highest ever' export revenue
guidance.margin: No range given; 'continued improvement every quarter'; aspiration to return to the old 21-22% margins; risks: energy and shipping costs (West Asia conflict)
guidance.capexFY27: ~Rs350 cr including Rs20-30 cr more into the wheel JV; no major capex until end-FY28 (Q4 call: Rs300-400 cr incl. Rs50 cr JV)
guidance.netDebt: Reduce leverage by at least Rs500 cr in FY27 to ~Rs1,500 cr (Q4 call: Rs400-500 cr)
guidance.workingCapital: Internal target 15-20 days improvement over about two years (~10 days a year)
guidance.utilisation: Press ~85% by end-FY27 (Q4 call); casting 85-90% in FY27; cold forging >70% by Q3FY27; 75-80% overall before the next capex; Rs9,000 cr revenue potential at full use of the present net block (asset turn 2.5x)
guidance.wheels: Rail wheel JV: trial production started; 300 sample wheels in Aug-2026; bulk supply from Sep/Oct-2026; 80,000 wheels on order from Indian Railways plus ~25,000 for the JV partner (enough for capacity use to end-FY28); capacity 2.3 lakh wheels; Rs400-450 cr revenue from the plant (Q4 call)
guidance.castings: Rs400-500 cr extra casting revenue in FY27, 15-16% margin (Q4 call)
guidance.mexico: Production started; ~Rs6 cr revenue in Q1FY27; 'significant' from Q3FY27
guidance.newMaterials: Aluminium forgings in bulk supply; stainless steel orders from Q4FY27; Inconel/titanium for aerospace, semiconductors and robotics 8-10 quarters away, zero order book today; Rs10-20 cr capex
guidance.trailerAxles: ~Rs120 cr in FY26, aim ~Rs250 cr in FY27 (Q4 call)
guidance.pvEv: PV (mostly EV) to be ~10% of revenue in two years (Q4 call)

inventoryIssue.what: During the FY25 year-end physical count the company found that book inventory of work-in-progress, raw material and scrap exceeded physical stock. A joint fact-finding study by independent external agencies (forensic imaging of devices, interviews of SAP custodians) reported on 14-Jun-2025 that 'erroneous accounting entries and non-recording of rejections at the manufacturing plants' had overstated inventory by Rs220.52 cr at 31-Mar-2025 and Rs50.22 cr at 31-Mar-2024.
inventoryIssue.accounting: Fully given effect in the FY25 standalone and consolidated accounts, including restatement of the FY24 comparatives (so FY24 as now shown is restated). Net-worth hit ~Rs202 cr (6.7%) per press reports. No fraud or misappropriation was alleged; disciplinary action against unnamed employees; SAP controls review.
inventoryIssue.promoterResponse: Promoter entity Riddhi Portfolio subscribed to 9,75,000 warrants at Rs2,100 (Rs204.75 cr, roughly the hit to net worth) when the stock was ~Rs580-600: 6,40,000 converted on 27-Mar-2026 and 3,35,000 on 9-Jun-2026.
inventoryIssue.ratings: CRISIL placed the rating on watch negative (Jun-2025) and on 19-Dec-2025 reaffirmed AA-/A1+ with a Negative outlook, removing the watch after corrective inventory controls; India Ratings downgraded to IND AA-/Stable from IND AA on 19-May-2026.
